'''Callie''' was a Wise Woman and one of the [[Kin]] based in [[Ebou Dar]]. 

== History ==
When she was put out of the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|995}} , she tried to take a small ''[[ter'angreal]] ''with her. ''"[[Peaceful illusions ter'angreal|A useless thing]] that makes images of flowers and the sound of a waterfall, but still an object tied to saidar."''{{Ref/book|7|17}} She also tried to find out other novices' secrets, succeeding more often than not. {{Ref|{{twotc}}, Callie}}

== Death==
She was captured by [[Falion Bhoda]] and [[Ispan Shefar]], questioned about the stash of objects of the One Power then murdered.

Her body was found by [[Sumeko Karistovan]] who realized that she was killed with the [[One Power]], rather than having her throat slit as first observed.

''"Callie is dead, Eldest Sister. Her throat was cut and she apparently had been robbed even of her stockings, but Sumenko says that is was the One Power killed her."''{{Ref/book|7|24}}
